SIBAL-cotton.why: BASS-II SIBAL fabric, lowest oxygen with a flame, 16.9% at 1 atm (NASA/TM-20210011385 Table 7.1)

small sample (glovebox scale).why: about 50 W, the figure given for BASS-II-scale flames in ICES-2019-101 (not re-verified; the summary memo says most tests were well below 100 W)

large sample (vehicle scale).why: 3,217 W peak, Saffire VI SIBAL by oxygen-consumption calorimetry (ICES-2024-365 Table 2)
